assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: three-panel introduction illustration for a Japanese parent-child home cooking web experience. Wide panoramic 3:1 composition divided into THREE EQUAL WIDTH square panels, separated by subtle cream gutters. Warm tactile paper-cut and watercolor, muted sage green and terracotta, calm everyday Japanese home. LEFT PANEL: young child standing a little away from a LANDSCAPE tablet securely propped on a dining table, both arms reaching out to catch illustrated carrot and bell pepper in a simple camera-controlled game, tablet screen facing child, view from behind child's shoulder so screen is legible, no tapping. CENTER PANEL: parent naturally looking at their own smartphone showing an ordinary curry recipe photo and small ingredient icons, beside a simple home pantry/fridge, screen faces parent, over-shoulder view. RIGHT PANEL: parent and child sitting together answering a short questionnaire on a tablet, the screen has simple blank rows and circular answer choices, view from behind/side. One simple clear action in each panel, matching scale and colors. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no headings, no logos, no stars, no watermarks. Keep key subjects within the center of each third so each panel can be cropped individually into a square card.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: landscape 3:2 feature illustration for a Japanese family cooking product. Warm tactile paper-cut and watercolor, cream background, muted sage green and terracotta, ordinary cozy Japanese home, simple uncluttered composition. A young child joyfully playing a camera motion-controlled food-catching game on a LANDSCAPE tablet securely propped on the dining table. Show child viewed from side/back three-quarter, standing or sitting a little away with BOTH HANDS lifted reaching out, not touching screen. Tablet screen is visible over their shoulder with a small friendly chef avatar reaching to carrot, tomato and green pepper icons, and three simple attribute badges with sun, leaf, water droplet pictograms, subtly conveying learning about ingredients within the same fun game. A second tiny game level/card inset on screen can hint richer variety, but no complex interface. Natural hands. No readable words, letters, numbers, nutrition claims, logos, watermarks. This is play and food education in an ordinary home, not a nutrition flashcard quiz.
